methods.title: Mesh Edit Mixin
methods.summary: Shared backend mixin for preserved PLY scan edits. Resolves source meshes from the edit chain on disk (filename_edit_N_operation.ply), loads and validates Trimesh geometry, writes new edits through PreservedMeshEditWriter (which also refreshes quick-grid projection PNGs), and propagates landmark JSON plus distance sidecars whenever topology or coordinates change. Edit filenames are the source of truth; the scan JSON stores mesh summaries and elastic metadata but not a full edit list.

options.name: directory
options.description: Project root directory containing extracted/.

options.name: filename
options.description: Scan stem name (folder under extracted/).

options.name: edit
options.description: Specific PLY basename to use as input, or "latest" for the highest-numbered _edit_* PLY.

algorithm.text: 1) Locate subject dir at extracted/{filename}/ and load {filename}.json metadata. 2) Resolve source PLY via edit argument or latest glob match on {filename}_edit_*_*.ply. 3) Load geometry with trimesh (concatenate multi-body scenes). 4) After an operation, allocate the next edit number, write {filename}_edit_{N}_{operation}.ply via PreservedMeshEditWriter.save, update landmarks for the new stem when present, and append mesh_summary to JSON metadata.
algorithm.diagram:
flowchart TD
  A[HTTP ApplyMesh* request] --> B[Load metadata JSON]
  B --> C[Resolve source PLY edit]
  C --> D[Load Trimesh]
  D --> E[Run mesh operation]
  E --> F[PreservedMeshEditWriter.save]
  F --> G[Propagate landmarks]
  G --> H[Update scan JSON metadata]

images.caption: Preserved-mesh edit chain: base PLY plus numbered _edit_N_operation.ply files

methods.title: Preserved Mesh Edit Writer
methods.summary: Canonical export path for every preserved-mesh PLY edit. Welds coincident vertices so downstream tools see one connected surface, writes the PLY to disk, then regenerates front and back isometric projection PNGs used by the quick-access mesh grid. All ApplyMesh* endpoints and mesh elastic registration save through this writer.

options.name: mesh
options.description: Mesh geometry to persist.

options.name: output_path
options.description: Absolute or relative path for the output .ply file.

algorithm.text: 1) ensure_welded_trimesh merges duplicate vertex indices along shared edges. 2) Export PLY with trimesh. 3) Call ensure_mesh_projection_pngs(output_path, force=True) to render transparent front/back isometric PNGs beside the PLY.
algorithm.diagram:
flowchart LR
  A[Trimesh] --> B[Weld vertices]
  B --> C[Export PLY]
  C --> D[ensure_mesh_projection_pngs]
  D --> E[Front + back PNG pair]

images.caption: Front and back projection PNGs regenerated after each PLY edit

methods.title: Ensure Mesh Projection PNGs
methods.summary: Creates or refreshes the front ({stem}_projection.png) and back ({stem}_projection_back.png) thumbnail pair for a preserved-mesh PLY when missing or stale. Skips work when PNG mtimes are newer than the PLY unless force=True.

options.name: ply_path
options.description: Path to the preserved-mesh .ply file.

options.name: force
options.description: When true, regenerate PNGs even if they appear up to date.

algorithm.text: 1) Compare PLY mtime against both projection PNGs; return early if current. 2) load_centered_preserved_mesh for display-normalized vertices. 3) Render isometric VTK screenshots (opposite view signs for front vs back). 4) Save composited RGBA PNGs next to the PLY.

images.caption: Isometric front/back projections used in the scan grid

methods.title: Generate Mesh Grid Preview JPEG
methods.summary: Builds a 2×2 JPEG mosaic (axial, isometric, sagittal, coronal orthographic renders) from a preserved-mesh PLY for richer grid or preview responses. Each quadrant is rendered at QUADRANT_RENDER_SIZE then pasted into a single composite image.

options.name: ply_path
options.description: Path to the preserved-mesh .ply file to preview.

algorithm.text: 1) load_centered_preserved_mesh. 2) Render four orthographic/isometric VTK screenshots with fixed camera setups. 3) Resize each to a common quadrant size preserving aspect ratio. 4) Composite into a 2×2 RGB image and encode as JPEG bytes (GRID_PREVIEW_JPEG_QUALITY).
algorithm.diagram:
flowchart TD
  PLY[PLY path] --> C[Centered mesh]
  C --> Q1[Axial]
  C --> Q2[Isometric]
  C --> Q3[Sagittal]
  C --> Q4[Coronal]
  Q1 --> G[2x2 JPEG mosaic]
  Q2 --> G
  Q3 --> G
  Q4 --> G

images.caption: Four-quadrant mesh preview mosaic returned as JPEG bytes

methods.title: Apply Mesh Crop
methods.summary: Clips a preserved-mesh PLY to an axis-aligned bounding box and saves a new _cropped.ply edit. Expands the box by optional padding, re-originates surviving vertices so the crop minimum becomes the new origin, and drops landmarks outside the box while re-originating kept positions.

options.name: directory
options.description: Project root directory.

options.name: filename
options.description: Scan stem to crop.

options.name: edit
options.description: Source PLY basename; omit to use metadata mesh_file or latest edit.

options.name: crop
options.description: Two corners [x0,y0,z0,x1,y1,z1] in mesh mm; min/max are taken automatically.

options.name: padding
options.description: Extra mm added outward on every axis before clipping.

algorithm.text: 1) Load source mesh. 2) Compute mins/maxs from crop corners ± padding. 3) Clip faces outside the box and shift vertices with reorigin_mesh_coords_after_mm_crop. 4) Write {filename}_edit_{N}_cropped.ply. 5) Filter and re-origin landmarks; copy subset of landmark distances.
algorithm.math: mins = min(corners[:3], corners[3:]) − padding; maxs = max(corners[:3], corners[3:]) + padding. After clip, v' = v − mins + padding.

images.caption: Axis-aligned crop box applied to a preserved craniofacial mesh

methods.title: Apply Mesh Slice
methods.summary: Interactive slicer for preserved meshes and voxel volumes. Accepts a list of wedge operations (convex volumes defined by plane sets from volumes or outline rays). For preserved meshes, save=false returns a GLB preview without writing; save=true (or commit=true) writes _sliced.ply or _sliced.nii.gz depending on scan type. Landmarks are kept or removed according to the same wedge rules as geometry.

options.name: directory
options.description: Project root directory.

options.name: filename
options.description: Scan stem.

options.name: edit
options.description: Source edit basename.

options.name: operations
options.description: Non-empty list of slicer operations (see action, volumes, outline_points, outline_rays).

options.name: save
options.description: When true, persist a sliced edit. Aliased by commit.

options.name: commit
options.description: Truthy alias for save.

options.name: operations[].action
options.description: "isolate" keeps geometry inside any wedge; "delete" removes geometry inside wedges.

options.name: operations[].volumes
options.description: Each volume supplies rays converted to plane sets; alternative to outline_points/outline_rays.

options.name: operations[].outline_points
options.description: Outline vertex indices paired with outline_rays when volumes is omitted.

options.name: operations[].outline_rays
options.description: Ray definitions parallel to outline_points; triangulated into wedge plane sets.

algorithm.text: For each operation: build plane sets from volumes or triangulated outline rays. isolate: clip mesh to each wedge and concatenate survivors; delete: subtract convex volumes from the mesh. Repeat sequentially. Mesh path uses view-projected plane clipping; voxel path masks foreground voxels in physical mm. Preview mode returns decimated GLB via _mesh_preview_payload without writing files.
algorithm.math: Point p is inside a wedge when dot(p − origin_i, normal_i) ≥ 0 for all planes i in that wedge.
algorithm.diagram:
flowchart TD
  R[operations list] --> A{action}
  A -->|isolate| I[Clip to wedge union]
  A -->|delete| D[Subtract wedges]
  I --> N[Next operation]
  D --> N
  N --> S{save?}
  S -->|no| P[GLB preview]
  S -->|yes| W[Write _sliced edit]

images.caption: Slicer wedge defined by view-projected planes isolating part of a mesh

methods.title: Apply Mesh Rotation
methods.summary: Applies a manual rotation from the Babylon 3D viewer to a preserved-mesh PLY and saves _rotated.ply. Converts the Babylon 3×3 display matrix (Y/Z axis flip relative to stored PLY coordinates) into raw mesh space, rotates vertices about quick_mesh_properties.center (or surface centroid fallback), and rotates landmark positions identically.

options.name: directory
options.description: Project root directory.

options.name: filename
options.description: Scan stem.

options.name: edit
options.description: Source PLY basename.

options.name: rotation
options.description: Babylon rotation payload; rotation._m must contain keys 0,1,2,4,5,6,8,9,10 forming a 3×3 matrix.

algorithm.text: 1) Extract 3×3 matrix from rotation._m. 2) Map to raw mesh basis: R_raw = diag(1,−1,−1) · R_babylon · diag(1,−1,−1). 3) Rotate vertices: v' = (v − c) @ R_raw + c. 4) Apply same transform to landmarks. 5) Write _rotated.ply and store rotation matrices in edit metadata.
algorithm.math: v' = (v − c) R_{raw} + c, where c is rotation_center from quick_mesh_properties.

images.caption: Manual rotation applied in the viewer then committed as a preserved-mesh edit

methods.title: Apply Mesh Cleanup
methods.summary: Removes disconnected mesh islands from a preserved PLY, keeping the largest surface-area component by default or all components above a minimum area fraction. Writes _cleaned.ply when components are removed; returns skipped status when the mesh is already a single component or cleanup preconditions fail (e.g. post-elastic edits).

options.name: directory
options.description: Project root directory.

options.name: filename
options.description: Scan stem.

options.name: edit
options.description: Source PLY basename; defaults to latest edit.

options.name: use_island_volume_threshold
options.description: When true, keep every component whose surface area ≥ min_island_volume_percent of total area.

options.name: min_island_volume_percent
options.description: Minimum component area as percent of total surface area (clipped to 0.1–30).

algorithm.text: 1) Build face adjacency graph via scipy connected_components on welded edges. 2) Score each component by surface area. 3) Select keep_indices (largest only, or all above threshold). 4) Drop faces from removed components, remove_unreferenced_vertices. 5) Drop landmarks whose nearest face was removed. 6) Save _cleaned.ply.

images.caption: Small floating islands removed from a thresholded mesh

methods.title: Apply Mesh Shell
methods.summary: Extracts the externally visible outer surface and saves it as a new edit. For preserved meshes: alpaca.get_outer_mesh on the PLY → _shell.ply. For voxel scans: marching cubes at threshold, outer-shell extraction, rasterize to a thickened volume mask (~10 voxel dilation), and save _shell.nii.gz plus lossy preview. Landmarks far from the shell surface are dropped.

options.name: directory
options.description: Project root directory.

options.name: filename
options.description: Scan stem.

options.name: edit
options.description: Source edit basename.

options.name: gaussian_blur
options.description: Optional Gaussian sigma applied to voxel volume before marching cubes (voxel path only).

algorithm.text: Preserved mesh: load PLY → alpaca.get_outer_mesh → trimesh cleanup → PreservedMeshEditWriter. Voxel: load NIfTI → optional blur → marching_cubes → outer shell → rasterize shell to binary mask → dilate 10 iterations → keep original intensities inside mask → write full-res and lossy NIfTI edits.
algorithm.diagram:
flowchart TD
  M{preserved mesh?}
  M -->|yes| P[alpaca.get_outer_mesh on PLY]
  M -->|no| V[MC + outer shell + rasterize]
  P --> S[Save _shell.ply]
  V --> T[Save _shell.nii.gz]

images.caption: Nested iso-surface reduced to a single outer shell suitable for NR-ICP

methods.title: Apply Mesh Snap to Mesh
methods.summary: Projects landmark positions onto the nearest point on the preserved-mesh surface (optionally the outer shell only), overwriting the scan's landmark JSON in place. Recomputes per-landmark distances and writes scan metadata statistics (mean/std, outlier counts vs voxel_size).

options.name: directory
options.description: Project root directory.

options.name: filename
options.description: Scan stem.

options.name: edit
options.description: PLY edit whose stem selects {stem}_landmarks.json.

options.name: use_outer_shell
options.description: When true, snap against alpaca.get_outer_mesh of the loaded PLY.

algorithm.text: 1) Load mesh (outer shell optional). 2) Read landmarks for edit stem. 3) alpaca.calculate_landmarks_closest_points moves each landmark to the nearest triangle surface point. 4) Write updated landmarks JSON and {stem}_landmark_distances.json with snap_distance array. 5) Update metadata.landmarks summary fields.

images.caption: Landmarks moved from float positions onto the mesh surface

methods.title: Mesh Elastic Registration Mixin
methods.summary: Implements Non-Rigid ICP (trimesh nricp_amberg) for preserved PLY subjects, mirroring voxel ElasticRegistrationView but keeping fixed vertex topology. Presets cover facial single-sheet surfaces and complex_mesh_volume (outer-shell-only NR-ICP with k-NN displacement upsampling). Optional template masking crops subjects to a warped reference ROI before the final elastic pass. Guidepoints, when present, initialize a Procrustes pose only.

options.name: mode
options.description: Preset: "facial", "complex_mesh_volume", or "custom".

options.name: mesh_elastic_custom_options.steps
options.description: Custom mode only: up to 6 rows [stiffness, normal_weight, max_iter]. Landmark weight is always 0.

options.name: mesh_elastic_custom_options.gamma
options.description: Custom mode NR-ICP gamma (0.01–10).

options.name: mesh_elastic_custom_options.eps
options.description: Custom mode convergence epsilon (1e-6–1).

options.name: distance_threshold
options.description: Custom mode correspondence cutoff in mm (0.01–0.5). Presets supply their own values.

options.name: use_vertex_normals
options.description: Enable normal terms in NR-ICP stages.

options.name: use_outer_shell
options.description: Extract outer shell on reference (and honor preset defaults).

options.name: outer_shell_only
options.description: Register decimated outer shells; upsample displacements back to full topology.

options.name: auto_extract_subject_outer_shell
options.description: Persist _shell.ply before NR-ICP; requires outer_shell_only=true.

options.name: mask_subject_with_template
options.description: Warp reference template to subject ROI and crop subject geometry (facial preset option).

options.name: mask_pad_centroid_fraction
options.description: Parallel-to-surface pad as a fraction of reference centroid size (0.005–0.20): max(|normal offset|, tangential exterior), a smooth along-surface ROI without the rounded isotropic rim tube.

options.name: tps_alpha_spacing_fraction
options.description: TPS regularization spacing fraction when TPS displacement propagation is used.

algorithm.text: 1) Load reference surface in registration frame (preserved mesh → shared mm; voxel → marching cubes). 2) Persist mesh_elastic_reference_ply in reference JSON. 3) For each eligible subject: optionally shell/mask, gather guidepoints for Procrustes init, run decimated NR-ICP (_run_mesh_nricp, cap ≈35000 verts). 4) Assert elastic output preserves source topology. 5) Save _elastic.ply, compute surface metrics, set elastic_to metadata.
algorithm.math: NR-ICP stages use stiffness w_s, normal weight w_n, landmark weight w_l=0. Surface score = 1 − fraction(distances > 6×voxel_size_mm).
algorithm.diagram:
flowchart TD
  Ref[Load reference surface] --> Persist[Save mesh_elastic_reference.ply metadata]
  Subj[For each subject] --> Shell{outer shell?}
  Shell -->|auto| SH[Write _shell.ply]
  Shell -->|skip| Mask
  SH --> Mask{template mask?}
  Mask -->|yes| MK[Write _masked.ply]
  Mask -->|no| NR[NR-ICP]
  MK --> NR
  NR --> EL[Write _elastic.ply + metrics]

images.caption: Subject mesh elastically deformed onto reference while preserving vertex indices

methods.title: Mesh Elastic Registration
methods.summary: Batch HTTP endpoint (POST mesh-elastic-registration/) that runs mesh elastic registration on all preserved-mesh subjects in a project. Skips the reference, faulty scans, subjects that already have an _elastic.ply edit, and applies flagFilter. Streams WebSocket progress to progress_group and returns a count of successful registrations.

options.name: directory
options.description: Project root directory.

options.name: reference
options.description: Reference scan stem (or atlas) to register toward.

options.name: flagFilter
options.description: Subject flag filter passed to apply_flag_filter (same as voxel elastic registration).

options.name: mode
options.description: Elastic preset or custom; see MeshElasticRegistrationMixin options.

algorithm.text: 1) Partition extracted folders into preserved-mesh scans. 2) Filter subjects (not reference, not faulty, no existing elastic edit, flag filter). 3) Load and persist reference surface. 4) Loop subjects with progress messages. 5) On success write _elastic.ply and elastic_surface_distance / elastic_error metadata. 6) Return 200 with registered count or 500 if all failed.

images.caption: Batch elastic registration progress streamed over WebSocket

methods.title: Load Mesh Elastic Reference Surface
methods.summary: Loads the reference triangle mesh used for mesh-elastic metrics and registration heatmaps. Resolution order: mesh_elastic_reference_ply from JSON (written at registration), preserved-mesh mesh_file PLY, dedicated voxel reference PLY basename, or marching-cubes fallback from the latest full-res NIfTI. Preserved-mesh results are mapped into the registration frame via mesh_elastic_reference_in_registration_frame.

options.name: directory
options.description: Project root directory.

options.name: reference
options.description: Reference scan stem or "atlas".

algorithm.text: 1) Open reference JSON (atlas.json or {reference}.json). 2) Try mesh_elastic_reference_ply on disk. 3) Else try preserved mesh_file PLY. 4) Else try {reference}_mesh_elastic_reference.ply. 5) Else marching cubes latest NIfTI with Gaussian σ=1, threshold from metadata, axes 0↔2 swap, reversed face winding.

images.caption: Reference surface shared by elastic metrics and heatmap views

methods.title: Prepare Heatmap Reference Mesh
methods.summary: Builds a display-budget reference mesh for per-vertex heatmap coloring on preserved-mesh subjects. The full-resolution mesh_elastic_reference.ply stays on disk for landmark propagation; this function decimates to vertex_cap (matching the subject display budget) and caches vertices/faces as NPZ beside the source PLY for fast reuse in MarchingCubesView dense distance computation.

options.name: directory
options.description: Project root directory.

options.name: reference
options.description: Elastic reference stem (elastic_to).

options.name: vertex_cap
options.description: Maximum reference vertices for heatmap queries (same cap as subject display mesh).

algorithm.text: 1) Resolve full reference via load path or marching-cubes fallback. 2) Return cached NPZ if vertex_cap and source mtime match. 3) Decimate full mesh to vertex_cap with _decimate_trimesh_to_vertex_cap. 4) Save {cache_stem}_heatmap_ref_v{cap}_vertices.npz and faces NPZ. 5) Return in-memory Trimesh for distance queries.
algorithm.diagram:
flowchart LR
  Full[Full reference PLY] --> Dec[Decimate to vertex_cap]
  Dec --> Cache[NPZ cache]
  Cache --> Q[Open3D closest-point queries]

images.caption: Decimated reference used for fast vertex heatmaps while full PLY remains for landmarks

methods.title: Compute Mesh to Reference Surface Distances
methods.summary: Computes unsigned Euclidean distance from each query vertex to the nearest point on a reference triangle mesh using Open3D RaycastingScene (same approach as MarchingCubesView dense_distances for voxels). Used for preserved-mesh heatmap coloring, elastic surface metrics, and template-mask quality checks. Processes vertices in chunks for memory efficiency.

options.name: query_vertices
options.description: Subject vertex positions in registration mm.

options.name: reference_mesh
options.description: Reference surface mesh (often decimated for heatmaps).

options.name: label
options.description: Optional log label for timing messages.

options.name: chunk_size
options.description: Number of query vertices per Open3D batch.

algorithm.text: 1) Build Open3D TriangleMesh from reference vertices/faces. 2) Create RaycastingScene and add triangles. 3) For each chunk of query_vertices, call compute_closest_points. 4) Store ||query − closest||₂ per vertex.
algorithm.math: d_i = min_{q ∈ surface} ||v_i − q||_2 (unsigned closest-point distance).

images.caption: Per-vertex distance field colored on an elastically registered subject mesh

methods.title: Mesh Elastic Surface Metric
methods.summary: Summarizes a distance array into the scalar scores stored on elastic subjects: fraction of vertices above threshold, elastic_surface_distance (1 minus that fraction), and mean distance in mm. Threshold is typically 6× reference voxel size, matching voxel ElasticRegistrationView surface scoring.

options.name: distances
options.description: Per-vertex distances to reference surface in mm.

options.name: error_threshold_mm
options.description: Acceptance threshold in mm (usually 6 × voxel_size).

algorithm.text: above_fraction = count(d > threshold) / N; surface_score = 1 − above_fraction; mean_distance = mean(d). Empty input returns (0, 0, 0).
algorithm.math: score = 1 − (1/N) Σ 𝕀(d_i > τ); mean = (1/N) Σ d_i.

images.caption: Elastic surface distance score derived from vertex-to-reference distances
